inherited_risk_from_a3.statement: hive_mind_os.verify.verify_bundle (src/hive_mind_os/verify.py:266-379) re-derives file digests but never reads document['verdict']; 'verdict' occurs at verify.py:58, 179, 185, 194, 250, none inside verify_bundle. A bundle whose verdict is flipped from reject to adopt is ACCEPTED once integrity.json is recomputed, because integrity.json is an unkeyed in-bundle manifest attesting self-consistency rather than authenticity. Any delivery pilot that ships artifacts on the strength of a retained bundle inherits that weakness. This plan therefore gates no remote operation on a retained bundle's verdict field.

how_it_was_ensured: No push, fetch, pull, clone, ls-remote, or remote add/set-url was ever invoked.
No gh CLI invocation, no curl, no HTTP client, no GitHub API call, no WebFetch, no WebSearch, no browser tool.
The only remote-adjacent command was `git remote`, which prints remote NAMES from the local .git/config and opens no connection. Its output ('origin') was used for nothing.

The focused suites are network-free: test_github_adapter drives an in-process FakeGitHubTransport and ExplodingTransport, and the single test that constructs UrllibGitHubTransport (test_default_transport_keeps_tls_chain_and_hostname_validation) only reads attributes off the TLS context object and issues no request; test_git_adapter operates on local fixture repositories, and test_repository_urls_are_rejected asserts URLs are refused.

Stated precisely rather than sweepingly: the suite DOES perform one real `git push`, at tests/test_github_adapter.py:487-505, into a bare repository the test creates with `git init --bare` in its own temp directory (remote_url=Path('.git')/bare.name, allow_local_test_remote=True). That is a filesystem path, not a network host. The `git push origin ...` argv at tests/test_git_adapter.py:444 never executes -- the test asserts it is denied with GitPolicyDenied before any process spawns.
Every command run in this node was one of: read-only git plumbing (rev-parse, status, ls-tree, remote, --version), read-only filesystem inspection, or the one focused unittest invocation.
no_remote_operation_proof.limits_of_this_proof: This is a first-person account of the commands this worker issued, corroborated by the session transcript and by the absence of any remote/ evidence directory. It is not an independently captured network trace. No egress monitor was in place; an auditor wanting stronger assurance would need one. Stating that limit is part of the proof being honest.
